description: This file contains methods for handling shared channel membership synchronization, including conflict checking, processing remote membership changes, adding and removing users from channels, and updating sync status.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service class providing shared channel membership synchronization functionalities.

methods.name: checkMembershipConflict
methods.description: Checks if there are newer conflicting membership changes for a user in a channel.

methods.name: onReceiveMembershipChanges
methods.description: Processes incoming remote cluster membership change messages, handling add/remove operations and conflict resolution.

methods.name: processMemberAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a user to a channel, including user upsert, permission checks, and sync status update.

methods.name: processMemberRemove
methods.description: Handles removing a user from a channel and updating sync status.
